summary: Master the art of data management and visualization tailored for financial managers. Enroll in our course to elevate your analytical capabilities today.
lede: Financial data analytics training helps finance professionals prepare, validate, and explain financial information for management decisions. It is designed for people who prepare, review, govern, or communicate financial results, including controllers, management accountants, data analysts, and finance business partners. Learners assess data quality and reconcile sources, analyze variances and performance measures, and create decision-focused dashboards using Excel Power Query and Power BI, while documenting assumptions and data limitations.
audienceIntro: This course suits finance professionals who prepare, review, govern, or explain financial information and need practical capability across the reporting workflow.
modules: Excel Power Query for Finance Workflows
COSO Controls and Financial Reporting Assurance
prerequisites: You need practical experience in finance reporting, budgeting, accounting, forecasting, or financial control. Familiarity with spreadsheets helps, but advanced Excel, SQL, coding, Power BI, statistics, or data engineering experience is not required. Coding and programming are not required for completion. Advanced analytics and AI-assisted financial analysis are taught at conceptual awareness and operational application levels, while Excel Power Query and Power BI exercises use guided, hands-on implementation.
